- Series: a Watch now button at the top of each season plays its first episode.
- Fixed the keyboard crash of 2.0.25 (the chemistry table called itself without end: a stack overflow when the keyboard started).
- Fixed the crash of the services list (the same service twice gave a repeated key).
- The update window scrolls.
- Keyboard: a word no list knows counts as a word after three uses (was two), so a slip typed twice stays corrected.
- Downloads: Android 16 Live Update request with the percent in the status bar chip.
- Messages: no launcher badge (all the extra apps share one package, so the badge showed on each); the notification stays.
- Game Hub settings: the number beside Select games says what it counts (hidden apps).
- Music: a listening log (ListenLog) saves every song that starts, online or on the phone, and learns the taste from how songs end (skips, finished, stars); songs and artists given up (stars 1 or 2, many skips) are left out of For you and the radio; online plays go to the history without a press.
- Recap: Save on the summary page saves the detailed receipt picture instead of the old plain card.
- Game Hub CD View: with many games the rack no longer stays on Loading (its remembered state was reset each time the screen drew, as the game list was a new object each time); it starts with the covers already known.
- Game Hub CD View: the rack shows at the first frame (a game with no cover yet is a soft coloured blotch, the real cover takes its place when it comes in); nothing waits for the cover search.
- Keyboard: a Google Keyboard theme (third in the picker): rounded keys on a blue-grey board with a mint action key; tones teal grey, smoke, black and Material; key borders can be switched off. The other themes are untouched.
- Toolkit: Spin the bottle (a tool and a Quick Settings tile; the tile shows the angle the bottle stopped at).
- Calculator: the history is a floating window over the calculator (the display and keys stay and show below it), not a page that replaces them.
- Keyboard, Samsung look: the emoji page has a row of round tabs on top (keys, emoji, symbols, kaomoji, settings, menu), the search glass and the categories in one row, and a round delete key floating over the emojis.
- Keyboard, Google Keyboard look: the emoji page has the back arrow, Search and round category icons (the open one in a white disc) on top, the name of the category above the emojis, and a bottom bar with ABC, the emoji pill, GIF, symbols, kaomoji and delete.
- Battery: the service watchdog no longer restarts a silent service for ever (it gives up after two hours: each restart was a foreground service with a live process, all night); Toolkit > Background use lists what of Pulse runs, with Stop, Stop all and a report to copy.
- Battery: the terminal's session ends after ten minutes without use and its wake lock is held a minute at a time (it was held for ever while the shell lived: the night's drain).
- Terminal: also an extra app (own launcher entry, in Settings > Extra apps); a star keeps a command as a favourite, typing offers favourites, history and usual commands; the history survives a restart.
- Keyboard settings: a 'Pick your features' list with the main switches in one place.
- Battery report: Settings > Report > Performance has a Background report (services and their age, process importance, jobs, watchdog list, keyboard in use, notification-service time today, and with root or Shizuku the wake locks, alarms, jobs and battery statistics of Pulse).
- Battery: the keyboard's file observers (pictures, videos, downloads, every file of the phone) are on only while the keyboard is shown; they woke the keyboard process all day and night.
- Terminal: see-through in the Windows 11 look also as its own app.
- Music: a 'Played' chip in the online browse page lists everything played (online and on the phone, from the listening log), filtered by All / Online / On the phone and searched with the search box; a tap plays it.
- Video: a pull down from the top edge sends the video to the small window (as Back does). Keyboard: a pull down on the emoji bar closes the keyboard.
- HTML viewer (Files and the code editor): the page's own viewport, stored data, zoom, https parts and scripts that alert or log, so pages made for a phone (AI output, saved pages) show whole.
- Keyboard, Google Keyboard theme: only the colours (tones, key borders); the emoji page layout of the first try was taken out.
- Keyboard: the mark on a typed word that looks like a kept slip is a small see-through white dot (it was red).
- Game Hub CD View: the rack is no longer baked again after every group of twelve covers (that never finished with many games): it opens at once and the covers that came in are handed over once at the end (and at most every 45 seconds while the search is long).
- Game Hub CD View: the shelf no longer leaves out the hidden games a second time ('No games on the shelf' while the other views showed them, when hidden games were asked for).
- Video player: the subtitle size is one slider (18 to 56) for upright, sideways or the small window, chosen on top; the selected choice is readable (it was white on white); the subtitle, speed and delete windows are AMOLED black; the speed button joins the bottom left bar (subtitles, rotation, speed, small window).
